exampleReadiness.blocker: The WebGL renderer still needs private visibility packets, manifest normalization, indexed geometry upload, and material texture resources before these lanes can become real examples.
exampleReadiness.nextPrototypeStep: Land the visibility packet extractor privately in renderer-webgl, then wire manifest-derived bounds into that packet stream before adding new examples.

stages.title: Visibility Packets
stages.blocker: No private renderer-webgl packet extractor is wired into pass rendering yet.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Add a frame-local WebGL packet buffer behind RenderPass extraction and report packet/visible/cull counters as private diagnostics.

stages.title: Asset Manifest Adapter
stages.blocker: Manifest normalization is still research-only and is not consumed by WebGL caches or examples.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Create a private manifest normalizer that can answer bounds and artifact lookup without opening payload files.

stages.title: Indexed Geometry Backbone
stages.blocker: packages/renderer-webgl/src/render-graph.ts still rejects non-box mesh geometry in the practical draw path.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Add a private IndexedGeometryData upload/cache path with Uint16 indices first, then route one research fixture through it without public exports.

stages.title: SVG Path Geometry
stages.blocker: Packed SVG paths need a renderer-private tessellation and indexed draw path before they can be rendered as examples.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Lower packed path output into IndexedGeometryData and validate bounds before upload.

stages.title: Material Texture Resources
stages.blocker: Current material binding does not have backend-private texture-resource indirection for variants, fallbacks, or residency diagnostics.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Add a private material resource record that can bind solid colors, ordinary textures, fallback textures, and later virtual texture resources.

stages.title: Virtual Texture Resources
stages.blocker: There is no WebGL-private page loader, page-table texture, physical cache atlas, or material binding path yet.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Consume visible packet material demand and manifest page ids in a private residency scheduler before exposing any route.

stages.title: SVG Tiger Demo
stages.blocker: The fallback tiger can be parsed and checked, but Royal cannot render packed path geometry through the normal mesh path yet.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Use the path geometry lowering path to render the fallback tiger, then vendor the full Ghostscript tiger only with recorded provenance.

stages.title: Terrain And LOD
stages.blocker: Terrain chunks need indexed geometry upload, instancing or packet identity, material resources, and manifest-derived bounds before a real example can render them.
stages.nextPrototypeStep: Feed deterministic terrain chunk rows into the private packet/manifest path and render placeholder indexed chunks before adding offline asset streaming.
